_purpose: LNES-59.2 blind holdout ground truth manifest. Supersedes the prior 27-case-era version of this file (which predated the holdout split entirely and explicitly said so). This is the sealed, authoritative record of what the 50 holdout cases' correct answers are -- lives only alongside LNES59_EVALUATOR_HOLDOUT.json, never alongside anything a tested arm can read.
supersedes: Prior version of this file covered the 27-case pre-scaling development set and explicitly stated holdout_status: NOT_YET_SPLIT -- obsolete since the 100-case development freeze (LNES59_FINAL_PRE_HOLDOUT_ARCHITECTURE_FREEZE.md) and this holdout construction.
ground_truth_derivation: Hand-derived from the frozen V7 rules by direct code-reading and manual trace, NEVER by running extract_case_state()/evaluate() against the holdout cases. Each case's expected_state field is the claim; each case's _hand_trace field (evaluator-only, never runner-visible) is the reasoning. Real extraction WILL run during Stage B execution -- comparing its output against expected_state/_hand_trace at that point is itself part of the residual autopsy (a hand-trace error is a benchmark-construction finding, not an architecture defect).
